messages:
Nora (Security): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on partner onboarding for SOC2/ISO. We promised a concise, actionable playbook and a short office-hours cadence.

Dev (CTO): Agree — make it operator-friendly. Split guidance by: VPC connectivity, BYOK/KMS, audit-log exports (format + retention), and the artifacts package for auditors.

Asha (Compliance): Minimal artifacts: system diagram, list of control owners, sample access-review evidence, key-rotation logs, signed shared-control attestation. ISO reviewers also ask for crypto algorithm details and key lifecycle notes.

Ibrahim (Infra): For logs we'll support daily JSONL exports to partner buckets or SFTP. Proposed filename: partners/<partner-id>/audit-YYYYMMDD.jsonl. Each line: ts, req_id, principal, action, resource, success, region. Example: `{"ts":"2024-10-12T22:30:12Z","req_id":"r_abc123","principal":"svc-partner","action":"Invoke","resource":"/v1/generate","success":true}`

Rae (DevRel): I'll own a partner README + quickstart checklist with sample commands and a BYOK verification step (one-command encrypt/decrypt). ETA: 10 business days. :+1:

Nora (Security): BYOK acceptance criteria (high level): key policy binds our service account, key access logging enabled, rotation cadence documented, and a simple test harness. Decide whether HSM-backed BYOK requires an extra security review.

Asha (Compliance): Also add sample support transcripts and incident ticket redactions to artifacts — SOC2 auditors sometimes request these.

Nora (Security): Action items: Rae — README + checklist due 2024-10-30; Ibrahim — log-export schema + manifest (sha256, retention) due 2024-10-20; Dev/Product — BYOK acceptance criteria and HSM policy due 2024-10-18; Asha — artifact checklist for SOC2/ISO due 2024-10-22. Confirm owners/dates. :thumbsup:

Dev (CTO): Confirmed. Recommend a pilot with one partner (suggest BeaconLabs) to validate end-to-end. Nora to coordinate pilot schedule.

sched-bot: "Partner Onboarding Office Hours" created — weekly Tuesdays 11:00-11:30 PT starting 2024-10-15. Calendar invites sent.

Ibrahim (Infra): I'll include a small JSON manifest with each export: `{\"date\":\"2024-10-12\",\"files\":1,\"sha256\":\"<sum>\",\"retention_days\":90}` so partners can verify integrity.

Rae (DevRel): I'll prepare a 10-min demo for the first office hours showing the README + BYOK test command.

Nora (Security): I'll create the shared doc at go/internal/partner-soc2-playbook and post link here when it's live. We'll review acceptance criteria at the next leadership sync. Thanks!
